title: Tabletop board-height scan (tabletop wave 2A, step 4)
authority: DECISIONS 2026-11-04 item 2 (the researcher): seeds and attempt budget fixed beforehand; scan all of 0.15/0.18/0.20/0.22/0.25 m; choose the smallest height that (a) admits foam brick and tuna can on both M16 sides and (b) retains the best S8/IND28 target support found across the whole grid, comparing identities and success rates, not only counts; if no height satisfies both, report that; taller boards are tabletop variants with exact dimensions.

base_config.note: make_tabletop_config.py base; board heights are null there and set per cell

board_dims_note: every board family at the scanned height (S8 0.08 m wide, M16 0.16 m, IND28 per ind28_widths_m; all 0.005 m thick), the other rules of the base config unchanged
ind28_widths_note: 0.28 m = the physical IND28; 0.36 / 0.44 m = candidate tabletop variants for the +-60 deg stops (design proposal section 4), scanned at every height
ycb_box_note: upright cracker box, upright sugar box, upright wood block, pudding box on edge; one choice per cell (height-independent)
white_box_note: height-independent cells (one per target), recorded; the class matrix decides its target list

probe_seeds.note: dev seeds 7000-7099, the SAME seeds in every cell (paired); try_place(seed, attempt 0), entropy [ENTROPY_SALT['tabletop'], seed]; disjoint from the slot seeds 5000-5059 / reserves 6000-6411

class_matrix_probe_seeds.note: dev seeds 7200-7299 for the class matrix at the chosen height

decision_rule.admitted: a target is ADMITTED in a cell if at least 1 of its tries_per_cell tries succeeds (same wording as the shelf exclusions: 0 of N tries = not admitted)
decision_rule.a: height h meets (a) if foam brick (21) and tuna can (6) are both admitted in M16-L and in M16-R at h
decision_rule.best_support: BEST SUPPORT of family F (S8 over the 5 heights; IND28 over the 5 heights x 3 widths) = (identities) the set B_F of targets admitted in at least one cell of F's grid, and (rates) for each target t in B_F its largest success count over F's grid, k*_F(t)
decision_rule.b: height h meets (b) if S8 retains its best support at h AND IND28 retains its best support at h for at least one width W. F retains its best support at h (width W) if for EVERY target t in B_F: t is admitted at h (W) and its success count k there is not significantly lower than k*_F(t): one-sided Fisher exact test of k/N vs k*_F(t)/N, p >= alpha (sim/feasibility.py fisher_one_sided_lower). Equal identities with a significantly lower rate fail
decision_rule.choice: H_T = the smallest scanned height meeting (a) and (b); all five heights are scanned whatever the outcome
decision_rule.ind28_width: the IND28 width at H_T = the narrowest width W meeting (b) at H_T; W > 0.28 m is recorded as a tabletop variant with its exact dimensions (W x H_T x 0.005 m)
decision_rule.none: if no height meets (a) and (b) the outcome is reported as 'no height satisfies' and no height is picked
decision_rule.ycb_box: a ycb_box choice is kept if it admits at least one of the five targets; the class matrix then decides the ycb_box target list
decision_rule.implementation: sim/feasibility.py decide_height (unit-tested on synthetic results in tests/test_sim_arrange_tabletop.py before the run)

after_the_scan.class_matrix: at H_T (all boards), the chosen IND28 width and the kept ycb_box choices: 100 real generator tries per (slot class, target), probe seeds 7200-7299; a class's target list = the targets with >= 1 success; the others are excluded with the reason 'no valid placement found in 100 tries'
after_the_scan.revisit_redraw_rate: rejected revisit draws per stop over the generated dev60 + TDES0-3 (scratch, not the share)

budget.estimate: smoke (26 cells x 2 tries, 5 workers): 0.59 worker-s per try; failing tries up to ~1.7 s. 175 cells x 100 tries = 17,500 tries: ~35 min expected, ~1.7 h worst case, under the 2 h limit, so the budget stays 100
budget.long_run: background process writing scan.log (not committed), cells.jsonl and results.json in this folder

smoke_disclosure: Before this plan was written the generator code was smoke-tested on dev seeds 9900-9911 and 9950-9961 (not used here) at a board height of 0.20 m (and 0.15 / 0.25 m in a 2-try pipeline check) for timing and for the parking rule: with the parked occluder's base centre required in frame at all 5 stops, 5 of 12 S8 parks succeeded (3 stops: 8 of 12; 1 stop: 12 of 12), so the base config requires >= 1 stop (on the seen table). No smoke result is used by the decision.
